mainEntity.name: What is the Prompt Career Connection?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Prompt Career Connection is a personalized matching service where clinicians and clinics find each other with intention. It connects clinicians with tech-forward clinics to surface meaningful, long-term clinical roles that support growth, mentorship, and sustainable careers.

mainEntity.name: Why does the Prompt Career Connection exist?

acceptedAnswer.text: To address clinician burnout by connecting clinicians with clinics that actually support growth. Prompt Career Connection bridges the gap between education, clinical experience, and long-term careers by matching people with tech-forward clinics built for modern care.

• PT, OT, SLP, and chiropractic clinicians exploring more fulfilling roles
• Clinics building a strong, aligned hiring pipeline

mainEntity.name: Is the Prompt Career Connection free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It’s free for both clinicians and Prompt-partnered clinics.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be actively job searching to participate?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You can submit your interest anytime and Prompt will match you when the right role opens.

mainEntity.name: How does this work for practicing clinicians?

acceptedAnswer.text: Share your goals, preferences, and timing once. Prompt handles the matching by proactively reaching out to vetted clinics that invest in modern technology and long-term career growth, and contacts you when a strong match is available.

Prompt clinics tend to invest in modern technology, prioritize mentorship and autonomy, support long-term clinical and career growth with alternative compensation models, and automate workflows that reduce admin burden and support better care delivery.

mainEntity.name: How does it work for clinics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clinics share hiring needs and timing and Prompt matches them with aligned candidates and facilitates introductions.
This isn’t a job board. Prompt accounts for where clinicians are in their journey and introduces opportunities as timing and fit align, resulting in less noise and more intentional connections.

mainEntity.name: What happens after a match is made?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prompt makes an introduction and the clinic and candidate take it from there.
